name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's introduction to motorsport wasn't through racing, but through tinkering. Growing up in São Paulo, he spent countless hours disassembling and reassembling discarded electronics, developing a keen understanding of how things work. This technical aptitude led him to a local security firm specializing in motorsport events, where he quickly impressed with his ability to identify vulnerabilities and implement effective preventative measures. He prioritizes a practical, no-nonsense approach to security, focusing on clear communication and meticulous planning.

His experience, while limited, is marked by a proactive mindset. Rafael is driven by a desire to create a safe and secure environment for all participants. He believes that a strong security presence shouldn't be intrusive, but rather a seamless and reassuring element of any motorsport event. His dedication and rapid learning curve make him a valuable asset, despite being early in his career. He aspires to be a leading figure in motorsport security, contributing to the safety and integrity of races worldwide.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a lean build and a serious expression.

quirks: Insists on checking every door handle three times before leaving a room.
Has a collection of vintage circuit maps.
